title: Equality cases for matrix spaces with bounded-rank commutators
summary: Let $0\leq k < n$, and let $\mathcal V\subseteq M_n(\mathbb C)$ be a complex linear subspace satisfying $\operatorname{rank}[S,T]\leq k$ for all $S,T\in\mathcal V$. Omladič, Radjavi, and Šivic proved the sharp bound $\dim\mathcal V\leq nk+\left\lfloor (n-k)^2/4\right\rfloor+1$ and conjectured a classification of the equality cases. We prove their conjecture.
